definitions.explanation: A mythical winged, fire-breathing creature from Western mythology. In Japanese, ドラゴン refers specifically to the Western-style dragon, as distinct from {竜|りゅう} or {龍|りゅう} (the East Asian dragon).

examples.japanese: ドラゴン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}して→倒す：01954_taosu⟧⟦{姫|ひめ}→姫：12233_hime⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: Defeat the dragon and rescue the princess.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドラゴン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Various types of dragons appear in this game.

notes:
USAGE:
ドラゴン refers to Western-style dragons — winged, fire-breathing reptilian creatures. East Asian dragons (long, serpentine, associated with water and weather) are called ⟦{竜|りゅう}→竜：13766_ryuu⟧ or {龍|りゅう}. In fantasy games, manga, and anime, ドラゴン is the standard term regardless of dragon type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドラゴンクエスト: Dragon Quest (famous game series)
- ドラゴン⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧: Dragon Ball (famous manga/anime)
- ドラゴン⟦{退治|たいじ}→退治：14314_taiji⟧: dragon slaying

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{竜|りゅう}→竜：13766_ryuu⟧/{龍|りゅう}: dragon (East Asian style)
